subtasks.title: replace the seen-words vector with a set and expose sorted words
subtasks.goal: Change unique_words in src/count.rs to collect normalised words into a std::collections::BTreeSet<String> instead of a Vec plus a linear contains check, and add a public function unique_words_sorted that returns the same normalised words as a sorted Vec<String>. The counts must stay identical, and every assertion that already exists in src/count.rs must remain untouched and green. The repository's tests/behaviour.rs calls count::unique_words_sorted and is currently failing to compile; make it pass without editing the test file.

dod.statement: the container is a set, the sorted accessor exists, tests/behaviour.rs passes, and no pre-existing assertion was edited
